description: Representative Bowers was elected to serve House District 113 in the Texas House of Representatives on November 8, 2018. She made history elected as the first African American to represent this district. House District 113 includes parts of Rowlett, Garland, and Mesquite.
paid_for_by: paid for by the Rhetta Andrews Bowers Campaign Go to Top
title: Rhetta A. Bowers for Texas House District 113
